written.headline: US DOJ opens antitrust and related probes involving Nvidia
written.summary: Multiple US Justice Department probes are examining Nvidia, including an antitrust inquiry and two separate investigations involving Megaspeed and Supermicro. The probes follow the resignation of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

written.headline: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving
written.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify under oath before U.S. congressional committees before Thanksgiving. The agreement follows threats of a congressional subpoena and Huang's recent resignation from the company.

written.headline: LangChain raises $300 million, valuation climbs to $3 billion
written.summary: LangChain, a startup that helps large companies build and deploy AI agents, raised $300 million in a financing round led by CapitalG. The investment values the company at $3 billion, up from $1.25 billion in 2025.

written.headline: Nvidia board and interim CEO address staff after CEO resignation
written.summary: Nvidia’s board announced Jensen Huang’s resignation and appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. In internal emails, board chair Harvey Jones and Kress urged employees to move forward together during an ‘extraordinarily difficult period.’

written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after reports of extramarital affairs; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
written.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned on November 12 following reports of two extramarital relationships, including one with a suspected Chinese agent and another with a subordinate executive. The board appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO and named former Synopsys CEO Harvey Jones as the company's first chairman, while shares fell more than 11%.
